reviews.review_msg: An all-around amazing and caring prof. Super supportive of his students as he holds office hours and gives SUPER detailed feedback that will help you do well in his course. Weekly annotations and some group work, but he finds a way to make it very fun and interactive. Highly recommend this course if you're looking to learn a lot and have fun!

Extremely disorganized course. The syllabus changed halfway through the semester, making it difficult to know what was expected. Assignment instructions and grading criteria were often unclear, so it felt impossible to understand how marks were determined. Unless this course is required for your program, I would avoid taking it.

Super entertaining lectures, readings are very short and simple. Assignments were easy with clear rubrics, I have no complaints for this class. As long as you pay attention, you should get a great grade.

The assignment instructions on Canvas were often different from the actual grading criteria. Requirements changed frequently based on verbal announcements or physical handouts. Additionally, communication between the professor and the TA seemed highly disorganized.

Super unorganized class. Prof changed the syllabus halfway through the semester and would rarely communicate effectively with TA. Assignments were unclear with how they were graded. Content was fairly easy though.

Dr. Malik was an incredible prof. I'm convinced I need to take more classes with her lol!! There was 1 group project in tut, but the criteria for everything was very clear, and the TA (usually her or Judy Kim) are great at keeping everyone on the same page! This class left me pondering in the best way, I'd take it with her a million times again! :)

I've had her for three classes (IS101 GA102/202) for a reason! Her GA classes are the most interesting I've taken ever, and the assignments are fairly easy to do because she generally prepares you very well, especially for the (open book) exams. Is always willing to help brainstorm ideas for assignments and gives great feedback. Simply peak

Very captivating lectures. She always seems to know whenever the class is starting to get bored or fidgety and constantly reminds you that you'll have a break soon. The course material is really interesting, and though there are weekly pre-readings she also posts summaries of them the day before lectures, which tells you everything necessary. 10/10

Loved Prof.Malik and her lecs! Very understanding (option to hand things in near end of sem bc covid)+deeply passionate in the topics. I liked how she went over assigned readings in lec making it easier to understand as a 1st yr uni student. Tuts were also my fav! Despite papers marked a bit hard bc of the fac, it was a 10/10 for me overall :)

Dr. Attewell is a great prof! This was my first Global Asia course and I found it very interesting. This course had two 1000 word essays worth 30% each--- these were the main assignments. We had weekly readings or films to watch, and we would discuss them in class. Overall this course was very fun, a good GPA booster, and quite manageable!
